 Dermatologist shares skin care tips for cooler weather 
 Dr. Camille Howard Varovic recommends a simple routine and ingredients that help skin retain moisture. 
 THE THREE(Recurring) EXTENDED By Desiree Ibarra Published : Nov. 9, 2026 at 5:19 PM CST | Updated : 1 hour ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google BRYAN, Texas (KBTX) - This segment on The Three was paid for and sponsored by CVS Health. 
 As cooler, drier weather arrives, paying attention to what your skin needs can help you choose the right products, a dermatologist says.
 Dr. Camille Howard-Verovic, a board-certified dermatologist and CVS Beauty dermatologist advisor, said dryness, irritation and scaling can offer clues about what products your skin needs.
 “First, you want to listen to your skin,” she said.
 Howard Varovic recommends keeping the basics simple: Cleanse, moisturize and protect your skin every day. She said sunscreen with an SPF of at least 30 is important even when it is cloudy.
 For hydration, she suggested looking for products with ceramides and hyaluronic acid. Ceramides help skin retain water, she said, while hyaluronic acid helps skin hold on to moisture.
 Howard-Verovic recommended CVS Moisturizing Cream, which she said contains both ingredients and can be used on the face and body.
 For more information, she directed viewers to CVS stores, CVS.com and the CVS YouTube channel.
